segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Kathryn and we've been traveling around the world eating different foods from different countries and today we're in Thailand.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，我们一直在世界各地旅行，吃来自不同国家的不同食物，今天我们在泰国。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Thai food is one of the most popular types of food around the world especially because of that specific Asian taste it has.
segments.zh: 泰国菜是世界上最受欢迎的食物之一，特别是因为它具有特定的亚洲风味。

segments.en: And so we're going to jump right into this dialogue today and see what we have prepared for you today.
segments.zh: 因此，我们今天将直接进入这次对话，看看我们今天为您准备了什么。

segments.en: What did you cook?
segments.zh: 你做了什么菜？

segments.en: Well, as you know, I was in Thailand last month and I took a cooking class.
segments.zh: 你也知道，我上个月去了泰国，还上了烹饪课。

segments.en: So I prepared some of my favorite dishes.
segments.zh: 所以我做了几道自己最喜欢的菜。

segments.en: Great idea.
segments.zh: 好主意。

segments.en: As long as I don't get food poisoning.
segments.zh: 好啊，只要别让我吃到食物中毒就行！

segments.en: So what is on the menu tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚都有什么菜？

segments.en: Okay, for starters we have Tom Yum soup.
segments.zh: 好，开胃菜是冬阴功汤。

segments.en: It's a bit spicy but really good.
segments.zh: 有点辣，但特别好喝。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: The ginger and lemongrass really give it a nice taste.
segments.zh: 姜和香茅让这汤特别鲜香。

segments.en: Now this next dish is one of the most famous.
segments.zh: 接下来这道也是最有名的菜之一。

segments.en: Foreigners call it papaya salad but the proper name is Tom Sam.
segments.zh: 外国人叫它木瓜沙拉，但正确的名字是 Tom Sam。

segments.en: It is a spicy salad made from a mix of fresh vegetables including shredded unripened papaya and tomato.
segments.zh: 这是一道辣味沙拉，用青木瓜丝、番茄等新鲜蔬菜拌成。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: The combination of sour and spicy is really interesting.
segments.zh: 酸辣搭配很有意思。

segments.en: I could have this every day.
segments.zh: 这道菜我天天吃都愿意。

segments.en: Okay, now for the last and best dish in my opinion.
segments.zh: 好，最后一道，也是我觉得最好吃的一道。

segments.en: This is called Pad Thai.
segments.zh: 这道叫 Pad Thai，也就是泰式炒河粉。

segments.en: Stir fried noodles with eggs, fish sauce, tamarind juice, red chili pepper plus bean sprouts, shrimp and tofu garnished with crushed peanuts and coriander.
segments.zh: 把米粉与鸡蛋、鱼露、罗望子汁、红辣椒、豆芽、虾和豆腐一起炒，最后撒上碎花生和香菜。

segments.en: It's practically Thailand's national dish.
segments.zh: 这简直就是泰国的国菜。

segments.en: Wow, this is great.
segments.zh: 哇，这太棒了。

segments.en: I never knew Thai food was so creative and delicious.
segments.zh: 没想到泰国菜这么有创意，还这么好吃。

segments.en: Want some more?
segments.zh: 还要再来点吗？

segments.en: I'm stuffed.
segments.zh: 我吃撑了。

segments.en: All right, so we've got a number of different dishes we'd like to talk about as well as phrases.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们有许多不同的菜肴以及短语。

segments.en: So let's look at some of those dishes and important key words in language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们看看语言要点中的一些菜肴和重要的关键词。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, so the first word we have on language takeaway today is food poisoning.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们今天关于语言要点的第一个词是食物中毒。

segments.en: So we don't want to get food poisoning when having this, any meal.
segments.zh: 所以我们吃这个、吃任何一顿饭时，都不想食物中毒。

segments.en: Any meal, no, that's right.
segments.zh: 任何一顿饭，不，是对的。

segments.en: Food poisoning is a bad thing.
segments.zh: 食物中毒是一件坏事。

segments.en: Now this is something that happens when you eat bad food or dirty food.
segments.zh: 现在，当您吃不良食物或脏食物时会发生这种情况。

segments.en: So you get very, very sick and you feel like you have to vomit, you have to throw up.
segments.zh: 所以你病得很重，你觉得你必须呕吐，你必须呕吐。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So your stomach hurts, you feel like you have to throw up, you may be going to the bathroom very often.
segments.zh: 所以你的胃疼，你觉得你必须呕吐，你可能经常去洗手间。

segments.en: That means usually you have food poisoning.
segments.zh: 这意味着您通常有食物中毒。

segments.en: All right, and so people often associate food poisoning with food that you eat on the street, maybe dirtier food.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以人们经常将食物中毒与你在街上吃的食物联系起来，也许更脏的食物。

segments.en: But this is something you should be very careful of when you're traveling, not to Thailand alone, but maybe to any other country.
segments.zh: 但这是你旅行时应该非常小心的事情，不仅仅是去泰国，而是去任何其他国家。

segments.en: You can get it in America, you can get it in Mexico.
segments.zh: 你在美国可能得，在墨西哥也可能得。

segments.en: So just something to be careful of.
segments.zh: 所以只是需要小心的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So apart from that, we're going to jump into our first dish for today.
segments.zh: 所以除此之外，我们来说说今天的第一道菜。

segments.en: We're having a soup called Tom Yum Soup.
segments.zh: 我们要喝一种叫冬阴功的汤。

segments.en: Tom Yum Soup.
segments.zh: 冬阴功汤。

segments.en: Now this is one of my favorite soups.
segments.zh: 现在这是我最喜欢的汤之一。

segments.en: It's quite spicy, isn't it, Marco?
segments.zh: 它很辣，不是吗，马可？

segments.en: Very spicy, but very, very good as well.
segments.zh: 非常辣，但也非常非常好。

segments.en: It has a kind of citric taste, like a lemon.
segments.zh: 它有一种柠檬味，像柠檬。

segments.en: It does, and it's very yellow or orange colored.
segments.zh: 是的，而且颜色很黄，偏橙色。

segments.en: And it's a very, very common dish on Thai restaurant menus.
segments.zh: 这是泰国餐厅菜单上非常非常常见的菜肴。

segments.en: And there are some key ingredients in this soup that I think are important to discuss.
segments.zh: 我认为这汤中有一些关键成分值得讨论。

segments.en: They're often found in Thai food and other kinds of Asian food.
segments.zh: 它们通常存在于泰国食品和其他亚洲食品中。

segments.en: The first one is ginger.
segments.zh: 第一个是姜。

segments.en: Ginger, that's right.
segments.zh: 姜，没错。

segments.en: This is a root.
segments.zh: 这是一种根茎。

segments.en: It kind of looks like a potato almost.
segments.zh: 它看起来有点像土豆。

segments.en: It does.
segments.zh: 看起来确实像。

segments.en: It's usually white and it has little arms, you know.
segments.zh: 它通常是白色的，还长着小小的突起，你知道的。

segments.en: It's not a round object.
segments.zh: 它不是一个圆形物体。

segments.en: It's got pointy little arms.
segments.zh: 它有尖尖的小手臂。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And the characteristic taste of ginger is kind of strong and bitter.
segments.zh: 而姜的特有味道是一种强烈而苦涩的味道。

segments.en: It is quite strong.
segments.zh: 味道相当浓烈。

segments.en: You'll find it in Japanese food.
segments.zh: 你会在日本料理中找到它。

segments.en: Sometimes you get pickled ginger to eat.
segments.zh: 有时你会吃到腌姜。

segments.en: It's like a pink food you get with sushi.
segments.zh: 就像吃寿司时配的粉色食物。

segments.en: Other times in Chinese cooking, it's something that's chopped up with garlic and cooked in oil.
segments.zh: 其他时候，在中国烹饪中，它是用大蒜切碎并用油煮熟的。

segments.en: So ginger is a very important one.
segments.zh: 所以姜是非常重要的一个。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in this soup, we have ginger and we also have lemongrass.
segments.zh: 所以在这汤里，我们有生姜，我们也有柠檬草。

segments.en: So this is very interesting because it's not very easily found around the world.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣，因为它在世界各地并不容易找到。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: This is very common in Southeast Asian cooking.
segments.zh: 这在东南亚烹饪中很常见。

segments.en: And you might have a hard time finding it in places like America where it's not really a part of the cuisine.
segments.zh: 你可能很难在像美国这样的地方找到它，因为它不是真正的美食的一部分。

segments.en: But lemongrass is very distinct.
segments.zh: 但柠檬草很特别。

segments.en: It has a very strong flavor and it's actually quite long.
segments.zh: 它的味道很浓，实际上很长。

segments.en: It's green and long.
segments.zh: 它是绿色的，而且很长。

segments.en: It looks a bit like celery, but it's harder.
segments.zh: 它看起来有点像芹菜，但更硬。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And the taste that it gives it is a little bit citric, kind of like a lemon almost.
segments.zh: 它带来的味道有点柠檬的酸味，几乎有点像柠檬。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But you're going to find this in soups like tom yum or other things.
segments.zh: 但你会在冬阴功之类的汤或其他东西里见到它。

segments.en: So lemongrass is another one.
segments.zh: 所以柠檬草是另一种。

segments.en: And then moving on to our next dish, which is one of the most, I think, the most popular dishes of all Thailand is the famous pad thai.
segments.zh: 然后继续我们的下一道菜，这是我认为，泰国最受欢迎的菜肴之一是著名的泰式炒河粉。

segments.en: Pad thai.
segments.zh: 泰式炒河粉。

segments.en: Now, this is absolutely my favorite Thai dish.
segments.zh: 现在，这绝对是我最喜欢的泰国菜。

segments.en: And I know that's very cliche.
segments.zh: 我知道这是陈词滥调。

segments.en: It's something that everyone says, but it's true.
segments.zh: 这是每个人都说的，但这是真的。

segments.en: You know, this is a great dish you can buy on the street.
segments.zh: 你知道，这是你可以在街上买的一道好菜。

segments.en: You can buy it in a restaurant.
segments.zh: 你可以在餐厅买到。

segments.en: It's basically a noodle dish, right?
segments.zh: 基本上是一道面条，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's stir fried noodles with eggs and peanuts are the most, like the key ingredients in there.
segments.zh: 它是炒面，鸡蛋和花生算是里面最关键的材料。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But you might also get a little bit of hot red pepper, some sugar, some lime.
segments.zh: 但你也可能会得到一点红辣椒，一些糖，一些酸橙。

segments.en: And the noodles are flat.
segments.zh: 而且面条是平的。

segments.en: They're not round.
segments.zh: 它们不是圆的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually one of the key ingredients also that gives it this very distinct taste is tamarind juice.
segments.zh: 实际上，赋予它这种非常独特味道的关键成分之一是罗望子汁。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Tamarind juice.
segments.zh: 罗望子汁。

segments.en: This is again another one of those flavors from Southeast Asia that you might not find in many other places, certainly not in America.
segments.zh: 这又是东南亚风味的一种，在很多其他地方可能都找不到，在美国肯定找不到。

segments.en: Now tamarind, they're funny looking things.
segments.zh: 罗望子这东西，样子长得有点怪。

segments.en: They look like peas, but they're dark brown.
segments.zh: 它们看起来像豌豆，但它们是深棕色的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So tamarind juice gives it this kind of sweet flavor.
segments.zh: 所以罗望子汁赋予它这种甜味。

segments.en: So this is the interesting thing about pad thai is that you have these sweet flavors from the tamarind juice, from even the fish sauce combined with chili.
segments.zh: 所以泰式炒河粉的有趣之处在于，你有这些罗望子汁的甜味，甚至是鱼露和辣椒的组合。

segments.en: So it's kind of like a spicy, very sweet taste.
segments.zh: 所以它有点像辣味，非常甜的味道。

segments.en: And then you have citrus.
segments.zh: 然后你有柑橘。

segments.en: You have some lime maybe and some sugar.
segments.zh: 你可能有一些酸橙和一些糖。

segments.en: So it's a lot of different tastes and flavors, but it's a really magical combination.
segments.zh: 所以它有很多不同的口味和口味，但这是一个非常神奇的组合。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that's all we have for language takeaway.
segments.zh: 这就是我们为语言要点所拥有的一切。

segments.en: Why don't we take another listen to our dialogue?
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再听听我们的对话呢？

segments.en: What did you cook?
segments.zh: 你做了什么菜？

segments.en: Well, as you know, I was in Thailand last month and I took a cooking class.
segments.zh: 你也知道，我上个月去了泰国，还上了烹饪课。

segments.en: So I prepared some of my favorite dishes.
segments.zh: 所以我做了几道自己最喜欢的菜。

segments.en: Great idea.
segments.zh: 好主意。

segments.en: As long as I don't get food poisoning.
segments.zh: 好啊，只要别让我吃到食物中毒就行！

segments.en: So what is on the menu tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚都有什么菜？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: For starters, we have Tom Yum soup.
segments.zh: 首先，我们有冬阴功汤。

segments.en: It's a bit spicy, but really good.
segments.zh: 它有点辣，但真的很好。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: The ginger and lemongrass really give it a nice taste.
segments.zh: 姜和香茅让这汤特别鲜香。

segments.en: Now this next dish is one of the most famous.
segments.zh: 接下来这道也是最有名的菜之一。

segments.en: Foreigners call it papaya salad, but the proper name is Tom Sam.
segments.zh: 外国人称它为木瓜沙拉，但正确的名字是汤姆山姆。

segments.en: It is a spicy salad made from a mix of fresh vegetables, including shredded unripened papaya and tomato.
segments.zh: 这是一种由新鲜蔬菜混合制成的辛辣沙拉，包括未成熟的木瓜和番茄丝。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: The combination of sour and spicy is really interesting.
segments.zh: 酸辣搭配很有意思。

segments.en: I could have this every day.
segments.zh: 这道菜我天天吃都愿意。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now for the last and best dish, in my opinion.
segments.zh: 在我看来，现在是最后一道最好的菜。

segments.en: This is called Pad Thai.
segments.zh: 这道叫 Pad Thai，也就是泰式炒河粉。

segments.en: Stir fried noodles with eggs, fish sauce, tamarind juice, red chili pepper, plus bean sprouts, shrimp, and tofu.
segments.zh: 用鸡蛋、鱼露、罗望子汁、红辣椒，再加豆芽、虾和豆腐炒成的面条。

segments.en: Garnished with crushed peanuts and coriander.
segments.zh: 用碎花生和香菜装饰。

segments.en: It's practically Thailand's national dish.

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: This is great.
segments.zh: 这太棒了。

segments.en: I never knew Thai food was so creative and delicious.
segments.zh: 没想到泰国菜这么有创意，还这么好吃。

segments.en: Want some more?
segments.zh: 还要再来点吗？

segments.en: So now let's take a look at four key phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看关于流利表达的四个关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So first up we have the phrase on the menu.
segments.zh: 所以首先我们在菜单上有这个短语。

segments.en: What's on the menu tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚的菜单上有什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That person asked, so what's on the menu?
segments.zh: 那个人问，菜单上有什么？

segments.en: And by saying this, we're saying, well, what are we having for dinner?
segments.zh: 话虽如此，我们是在说，好吧，我们晚餐吃什么？

segments.en: What are we going to eat?
segments.zh: 我们要吃什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you might want to think, okay, menu, I'm going to look at the menu, but you could even say this at home where there is no menu.
segments.zh: 所以你可能想想，好吧，菜单，我会看看菜单，但你甚至可以在家里没有菜单的地方这么说。

segments.en: This is a spoken language way of saying, what are we eating tonight?
segments.zh: 这是一种口语表达方式，我们今晚吃什么？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: What's for dinner?
segments.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

segments.en: What are we eating?
segments.zh: 我们在吃什么？

segments.en: What's on the menu?
segments.zh: 菜单上有什么？

segments.en: Even though, as you said, there's no menu.
segments.zh: 尽管，正如你所说，没有菜单。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And after that, we have another phrase that's really important.
segments.zh: 在那之后，我们还有另一个非常重要的短语。

segments.en: We say, for starters, we're going to have this or that.
segments.zh: 我们说，首先，我们将拥有这个或那个。

segments.en: So for starters.
segments.zh: 所以对于初学者。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We said for starters, we are having a soup, a Tom Yum soup.
segments.zh: 我们先说，我们要喝汤，冬阴功汤。

segments.en: So a starter dish is something that you have to begin the meal, a small dish maybe.
segments.zh: 所以开胃菜是用来开始一顿饭的，可能是一道小菜。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Start, starter.
segments.zh: start（开始），starter（开胃菜）。

segments.en: So a starter is a noun, it's a thing, and it's something you eat at the beginning.
segments.zh: 所以 starter 是个名词，指一样东西，是你一开始吃的东西。

segments.en: Usually it's not very heavy.
segments.zh: 通常它不是很重。

segments.en: A steak would never be a starter, right?
segments.zh: 牛排永远不会是开胃菜，对吧？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So here we have Tom Yum soup, which is our starter.
segments.zh: 所以在这里我们有冬阴功汤，这是我们的开胃菜。

segments.en: And after that, we have the national dish.
segments.zh: 在那之后，我们有了国菜。

segments.en: Now this is a great phrase.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个很好的短语。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We had the Pad Thai, which is considered to be the national dish.
segments.zh: 我们有泰式炒河粉，它被认为是国菜。

segments.en: And so usually every country has their national dish, something that's unique or that a country is famous for.
segments.zh: 所以通常每个国家都有自己的国菜，是本国独有、或以之闻名的一道菜。

segments.en: Like, for example, China would be famous for?
segments.zh: 例如，中国会以什么而闻名？

segments.en: Kung Pao chicken.
segments.zh: 宫保鸡丁。

segments.en: Kung Pao chicken, yeah.
segments.zh: 宫保鸡丁，是的。

segments.en: In America, you might even say that apple pie is the most important national dish.
segments.zh: 在美国，你甚至可以说苹果派是最重要的国菜。

segments.en: But do you guys have one in Ecuador?
segments.zh: 但你们厄瓜多尔有吗？

segments.en: What's your national dish?
segments.zh: 你的国菜是什么？

segments.en: I would say, I have no idea which would be.
segments.zh: 我会说，我不知道会是什么。

segments.en: It's not very well known.
segments.zh: 它不是很出名。

segments.en: Maybe ceviche is kind of shared between Peru and Ecuador.
segments.zh: 也许酸橘汁腌鱼算是秘鲁和厄瓜多尔共有的。

segments.en: Like maybe in Argentina, you would say steak is a national dish.
segments.zh: 就像在阿根廷一样，你会说牛排是一道国菜。

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely.
segments.zh: 是的，绝对。

segments.en: Or in Mexico, you know, like tacos or enchiladas, stuff like that.
segments.zh: 或者在墨西哥，你知道，比如炸玉米饼或辣酱玉米饼馅之类的东西。

segments.en: Or in Italy, spaghetti bolognese.
segments.zh: 或者在意大利，意大利肉酱面。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we have a number of different countries and each country maybe has one or two national dishes.
segments.zh: 所以我们有许多不同的国家，每个国家可能有一两个国家菜肴。

segments.en: These are very special dishes that are important for that country.
segments.zh: 这些是对那个国家很重要的非常特别的菜肴。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we have our national dishes.
segments.zh: 所以我们有我们的国家菜肴。

segments.en: And after we finish dinner, we ate so much that we say, I'm stuffed.
segments.zh: 吃完晚饭后，我们吃得太多了，会说，我吃撑了。

segments.en: I'm stuffed.
segments.zh: 我吃撑了。

segments.en: Now this is a common phrase that you will hear at the end of a meal when you've eaten and eaten and eaten.
segments.zh: 这是用餐结束时常听到的一句话，当你吃啊吃、吃个不停的时候。

segments.en: And it just means I'm full.
segments.zh: 它只是说我吃饱了。

segments.en: I'm full.
segments.zh: 我吃饱了。

segments.en: I can't eat anymore.
segments.zh: 我不能再吃了。

segments.en: Yeah, I'm stuffed.
segments.zh: 是的，我吃撑了。

segments.en: So stuffed means that I'm full of things.
segments.zh: stuffed 就是吃得很饱、肚子里塞满了东西。

segments.en: Now it's a very informal way of saying I'm full, right?
segments.zh: 现在这是一种非常非正式的方式来表达我的饱腹感，对吧？

segments.en: Because if somebody says, would you like some more soup?
segments.zh: 因为如果有人说，你想再喝点汤吗？

segments.en: You say, no, thank you.
segments.zh: 你说，不，谢谢。

segments.en: I'm full.
segments.zh: 我吃饱了。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: But if you're with friends, you can say, oh, I just had so much pizza.
segments.zh: 但如果你和朋友在一起，你可以说，哦，我只是吃了这么多披萨。

segments.en: I'm stuffed.
segments.zh: 我吃撑了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's a little bit more informal, but a lot more native-like.
segments.zh: 所以它有点不那么正式，但更地道。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to our dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 所以我们最后再听一遍对话。

segments.en: What did you cook?
segments.zh: 你做了什么菜？

segments.en: Well, as you know, I was in Thailand last month and I took a cooking class.
segments.zh: 你也知道，我上个月去了泰国，还上了烹饪课。

segments.en: So I prepared some of my favorite dishes.
segments.zh: 所以我做了几道自己最喜欢的菜。

segments.en: Great idea.
segments.zh: 好主意。

segments.en: As long as I don't get food poisoning.
segments.zh: 好啊，只要别让我吃到食物中毒就行！

segments.en: So what is on the menu tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚都有什么菜？

segments.en: OK, for starters, we have Tom Yum soup.
segments.zh: 好的，首先，我们有冬阴功汤。

segments.en: It's a bit spicy, but really good.
segments.zh: 它有点辣，但真的很好。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: The ginger and lemongrass really give it a nice taste.
segments.zh: 姜和香茅让这汤特别鲜香。

segments.en: Now, this next dish is one of the most famous.
segments.zh: 现在，下一道菜是最著名的菜肴之一。

segments.en: Foreigners call it papaya salad, but the proper name is Tom Sam.
segments.zh: 外国人称它为木瓜沙拉，但正确的名字是汤姆山姆。

segments.en: It is a spicy salad made from a mix of fresh vegetables, including shredded unripened papaya and tomato.
segments.zh: 这是一种由新鲜蔬菜混合制成的辛辣沙拉，包括未成熟的木瓜和番茄丝。

segments.en: This is delicious.
segments.zh: 真好吃。

segments.en: The combination of sour and spicy is really interesting.
segments.zh: 酸辣搭配很有意思。

segments.en: I could have this every day.
segments.zh: 这道菜我天天吃都愿意。

segments.en: OK, now for the last and best dish, in my opinion.
segments.zh: 好的，现在是最后和最好的菜，在我看来。

segments.en: This is called Pad Thai.
segments.zh: 这道叫 Pad Thai，也就是泰式炒河粉。

segments.en: It's stir fried noodles with eggs, fish sauce, tamarind juice, red chili pepper, plus bean sprouts, shrimp and tofu, garnished with crushed peanuts and coriander.
segments.zh: 这是炒面，配鸡蛋、鱼露、罗望子汁、红辣椒，再加豆芽、虾和豆腐，最后撒上碎花生和香菜。

segments.en: It's practically Thailand's national dish.
segments.zh: 这简直就是泰国的国菜。

segments.en: Wow, this is great.
segments.zh: 哇，这太棒了。

segments.en: I never knew Thai food was so creative and delicious.
segments.zh: 没想到泰国菜这么有创意，还这么好吃。

segments.en: Want some more?
segments.zh: 还要再来点吗？

segments.en: I'm stuffed.
segments.zh: 我吃撑了。

segments.en: All right, so speaking of Thai food, it's very famous around the world, but it's very spicy.
segments.zh: 好吧，说到泰国菜，它在世界各地都很有名，但它很辣。

segments.en: It can be very spicy, and what always surprises me about Thai food is that the salads might be the spiciest things on the menu.
segments.zh: 它可能非常辣，泰国菜总让我惊讶的一点是，沙拉竟然是菜单上最辣的东西。

segments.en: People like to eat many different salads.
segments.zh: 人们喜欢吃许多不同的沙拉。

segments.en: You have a Chiang Mai chicken salad or you have a papaya salad, but these are really, really spicy.
segments.zh: 你有清迈鸡肉沙拉，或者你有木瓜沙拉，但这些真的非常辣。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: We have a line in our dialogue that we're eating papaya salad, and it's very interesting because it has this fruit, papaya, and it has some other vegetables as well, but the salad is very, very spicy itself.
segments.zh: 我们在对话里有一句台词说到我们在吃木瓜沙拉，这很有意思，因为它有木瓜这种水果，还有别的蔬菜，但沙拉本身非常非常辣。

segments.en: That's right, and you would never think of a fruit salad as being something that's spicy in America.
segments.zh: 没错，在美国，你绝不会想到水果沙拉会是辣的。

segments.en: You'd think of it as being pretty tame, pretty boring.
segments.zh: 你会觉得它挺平淡、挺无聊的。

segments.en: But that's what gives it a certain attraction to it, right?
segments.zh: 但这就是赋予它某种吸引力的原因，对吧？

segments.en: Absolutely, and I don't know if you're a big fan of Thai food.
segments.zh: 当然，我不知道你是否是泰国菜的忠实粉丝。

segments.en: I certainly am, and I really like that about Thai food, that you can have these really spicy dishes, but there's just so much flavor.
segments.zh: 我当然是，我真的很喜欢泰国菜这一点：你可以吃到这些非常辣的菜，但味道还特别丰富。

segments.en: There's so many things happening, lemongrass, sugar, lime, fish sauce.
segments.zh: 发生了很多事情，柠檬草、糖、酸橙、鱼露。

segments.en: Yeah, it's very, very good.
segments.zh: 是的，非常非常好。

segments.en: And speaking of national dishes, this is actually a very interesting question because as we mentioned, a couple of countries have national dishes like Italy and different places, but what about in your country?
segments.zh: 说到国菜，这其实是个很有趣的问题，因为正如我们提到的，像意大利等几个国家都有自己的国菜，那你的国家呢？

segments.en: Do you have a national dish or what would you consider to be your national dish?
segments.zh: 你有国菜还是你认为你的国菜是什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we'd love to hear from you guys.
segments.zh: 所以我们很想听听你们的意见。

segments.en: What's your national dish?
segments.zh: 你的国菜是什么？

segments.en: Tell us all about it, what it tastes like, and even if there's some history, tell us about that too.
segments.zh: 给我们好好讲讲它，它是什么味道，如果有历史典故，也一并告诉我们。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right, we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 好，到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye, everybody, muah.
segments.zh: 再见，大家，muah。
